overview_description.description:
Roforco runs a Roblox game accelerator that makes games successful by providing funding, resources and hands-on support. 

It's YCombinator for Roblox games, built by two YCombinator Alumni.  Co-founders Artem and Brain have been building games together since they were 14 were developers on 12 top grossing titles, accounting for over 2.74 billion plays/downloads.

Prior to building the accelerator, Roforco was a game studio with a portfolio of games that reached benchmarks including 10 million monthly active users and 16,000 concurrent users. Roforco also worked with notable brands such as Unilever, for whom they made an branded game with over 50 million plays.

In 2022, Roforco joined YCombinator's coveted startup accelerator and went on to secure a $1.5 million seed funding round from investors including Paul Graham, Dentsu Group, the prev. COO of Activision and the CEOs of Guilded and Jellysmack. 

Learn more about us at https://roforco.com/

For press: tom@roforco.com
Based and founded in San Francisco, CA

product.name: Funding
product.description: Roforco provides up to $30,000 in funding for Roblox game development, in exchange for a minority share of the game's revenue.

product.name: Partnerships with Influencers
product.description: Roforco connects games with major influencers to increase game visibility and player base.

product.name: 1-1 Guidance from Veteran Developers
product.description: Offers personalized mentorship from experienced Roblox developers to guide game development.

product.name: Access to Top Talent
product.description: Facilitates hiring by providing access to a network of pre-vetted contractors and hiring support.

product.name: Exclusive Developer Community
product.description: Provides access to a community of ambitious developers for networking and support.

product.name: LiveOps Support
product.description: Offers data-driven live operations support to extend the lifetime and improve monetization of games.
